Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip1: DingDong: Pack a return route before a long underground expedition.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip2: DingDong: A spare light source can make an unfamiliar cave easier to explore.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip3: DingDong: Leave space for a door when building your next room.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip4: DingDong: Different weapons reward different approaches to the same fight.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip5: DingDong: Check your equipment before travelling far from home.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip6: DingDong: A landmark near a cave entrance helps you find it again.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip7: DingDong: Keep a little room in your inventory for unexpected discoveries.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip8: DingDong: A safe resting place is useful between expeditions.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip9: DingDong: A fishing trip can be part of exploring a new region.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip10: DingDong: Agree on the mod versions before starting a multiplayer session.
Mods.CalamityRuTranslate.GameTips.Tip11: DingDong: Keep a backup of your world before changing your mod setup.
